description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, senior team building AI agents for industrial operations. As a forward-deployed engineer, you will work directly with customers to integrate and launch the product in their environments, then bring field learnings back to the product team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Embed with customers to onboard data, run demos and proofs of concept, and deploy the product across their plants.

 - Build and tailor integrations with SCADA, PLCs, historians, MES, and ERP or CMMS systems.

 - Design clear, focused interfaces for industrial operators.

 - Lead workshops and training sessions to support customer adoption.

 - Translate customer feedback and field observations into actionable product improvements.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three or more years of full-stack engineering experience, including work with enterprise customers and translating their needs into technical solutions.

 - Proficiency in Go and TypeScript, with production experience building LLM-powered applications and backend systems.

 - Hands-on experience with Docker, AWS or Azure, graph databases such as Neo4j, and data ingestion pipelines.

 - Experience with relevant tools and technologies such as Node.js, React, Postgres, and LLM APIs.

 - Familiarity with industrial systems and workflows is valuable, including SCADA, PLCs, historians, MES, and ERP or CMMS platforms.

 - Strong communication skills and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $180,000 to $350,000 USD annually.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, United States. Regular travel to customer sites is expected.
